utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?
I think it's in the living room, dear.
Oh, I was actually asking how you've been doing lately. Are you feeling okay?
Alright, dear. Let me know if you need anything else.
Thanks, Grandma! I just wanted to make sure you're doing well. Let me know if you need anything too.
I'm sorry if it seems that way, dear. I'll try to do better. Let's go over it again together.
No need to apologize, Grandma. I just want to make sure we're both on the same page. Let's go over it together.
Alright, let's take it step by step. I'm sure we'll get it right this time.
Great! I'm glad we're doing this together. It'll be fun to figure it out step by step.
Thank you for your patience, dear. Let's try it together once more.
You're welcome, Grandma! I'm always here to help. Let's get started.
Yes, I can try counting like that. Let's give it another go.
Alright, let's start with the first step. I'll guide you through it.
Yes, I'm ready. Let's start counting together.
Great! Let's start with counting to ten slowly, and I'll be right here if you need any help.
Oh, I see. I'll try to keep pace with the tick-tocks this time. Thank you for pointing that out.
You're doing great, Grandma! Just keep going at your own pace.
Oh, you sound wonderful, dear! Let's play that song together. I'm sure you'll do great on the vocal track.
Thanks, Grandma! I'm excited to sing with you. Let's make it a fun duet!
Alright, I'll hold my arms out like you said. Let's see how it goes with the tick-tocking. I'm here to help however I can.
Great, Grandma! Let's start with the first verse and see how it goes. I'm sure we'll sound amazing together.
Alright, dear, I'll make sure to say tick-tock at the right times. Let's try it again together.
You're doing a great job explaining, dear. Let's keep practicing until we get it just right.
Thanks, Grandma! I'm really enjoying this. Let's keep going and have fun with it!
Alright, I'll use my third finger. Let's keep going, dear.
You're really getting the hang of this, dear. I'm so proud of you!
Thanks, Grandma! I'm so glad you're proud of me. Let's keep practicing together!
Thank you for being so patient with me, dear. I'm learning a lot from you!
I'm happy to help, Grandma! It's fun learning together.
I'm sorry, dear, I didn't mean to interrupt you. Please continue.
No worries, Grandma! I was just saying how much I enjoy our time together.
